title: Report guard accepts "the refusal was right" for a stray agent call
why: Three incidents on Nov 1: after auto mode rightly refused a stray agent call, the report guard forced an "allow <tool>?" owner question each time: merge-lock-record-drift (create_session, 22:12 CST), roles-follow-ruling (interrupt_session, 23:17), worktree-base-copies-remove (interrupt_session, 23:48). Each recommended keeping the refusal, which is main's state, so none was filed, and each cost a question round.
note: The report guard asks for an allow line only when the refused call was in the agent's brief scope, or accepts "refusal was right" as the answer. A guard verdict change: red first on the three forms. Ready. Port: yes.
